subject: Penetration test report request & on-screen review option
messages:
From: Elena Martin <elena.martin@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for full pen test report and remediation timeline

Hi Monica,

Hope you’re well. As part of our vendor assessment for Acme Health, our security team would like the latest penetration test report for Redwood Inference along with the scope and a high level remediation status for any critical/ high findings. We need this to complete a SIG questionnaire and to share with our internal risk committee.

Could you provide the full report (including raw findings) or, if that's not possible, let us know what alternatives are available (executive summary, redacted report, or controlled review)? Also please confirm the date of the test and which environments were in scope.

Thanks,
Elena Martin
Security Program Manager
Acme Health
security@acmehealth.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martin <elena.martin@acmehealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Oct 2025 16:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for full pen test report and remediation timeline

Elena —

Thanks for reaching out and for the context. We appreciate Acme Health’s diligence. I checked with our security and legal teams; Redwood does not share full raw penetration test reports externally for operational security reasons. However, we can offer the following options: 

1) Executive/technical summary that includes scope, test date (we last tested 2025-08-18), classification of findings (critical/high/medium/low), and remediation status for any critical/high items.
2) Redacted report with sensitive exploit details removed (shared under NDA).
3) Controlled on-screen review of the full report — a joint session where we walk through the findings with your team; available after an NDA and a short access review.

I’ve looped in Rishi (Security) and Stephanie (Legal) to help with the summary and to prepare a template NDA if needed. Which option would you prefer and what timeline are you working to?

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: NDA_Redwood_Template.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)]

From: Elena Martin <elena.martin@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request for full pen test report and remediation timeline

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the quick reply. We prefer to do a controlled on-screen review if possible; our risk committee likes to see the full context. A couple of clarifying questions before we proceed: 

- Will the on-screen review include demonstration of exploit steps or just the narrative and PoC screenshots?
- If there are critical/high findings, can you provide current remediation ETA and whether patches are already scheduled?
- What do you need from us (signed NDA, attendee list, IP allowlist)?

We’re hoping to close the SIG + CAIQ by Oct 20; ideally the review would happen next week.

Best,
Elena

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martin <elena.martin@acmehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Oct 2025 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test summary & next steps for on-screen review

Hi Elena —

Thanks for outlining the requirements. Per Monica’s note, Redwood’s standard practice is: no distribution of raw exploit artifacts; we can do controlled on-screen reviews under NDA. I’m attaching an executive/technical summary now and providing concise answers below.

Attachment: PenTest_Summary_v2.pdf (PDF, 245 KB) — contains scope, test date (2025-08-18), affected components (serving runtime and control plane connectors in our hosted environment), and consolidated findings.

Summary answers:
- The controlled review includes full narrative and PoC screenshots; we will not run live exploits or provide step-by-step exploit scripts. Any interactive demos are sandboxed and staged.
- Critical/high findings (2 critical, 5 high) have the following status: 
  * CR-2025-01 (critical): fixed in production 2025-09-05; mitigation validated by internal retest.
  * CR-2025-02 (critical): compensation controls in place; code fix planned with ETA 2025-10-22, scheduled change window 2025-10-20 to 2025-10-22.
  * High items: prioritized, most scheduled for fixes by 2025-11-01.
- We require a signed NDA (attached template), list of attendees with company emails, and an IP address allowlist for the on-screen session. We will provide a DocuSign link for the NDA and propose 60-minute session slots.

Next steps: if you confirm the attendee list and sign the NDA, we’ll provide available slots (we have openings 2025-10-10 and 2025-10-13 PT).

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Security
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PenTest_Summary_v2.pdf (PDF, 245 KB)]
